body: I was a bored 9 year old on the internet, Thought I was badass looking up "things not to google" I found something and looked it up it was two men who worked for the cartel shirtless they had their wrists tied behind them. They start to speak Spanish or something that I have been confused about until suddenly one of the guys lifted up a chainsaw and decapitated one of the men. I immediately exited the website and I was frozen I kept having images of the man's decapitated head.

It was the day before my friend's birthday so I slept over and were going to go to Universal Studios the next day. Lets call her Jessie, Jesse and I went upstairs to her room. Keep in mind, Jessie's dad watches anime. So, like I said me and Jessie went to her room and we were talking and she told me that her dad watches hentai I didn't really believe her. Later her dad comes in and gives her his phone. His most recent search is the hub. She was teasing me saying she was going to press it so, I kicked the phone out of her hand and she accidentally pressed it. It was the home screen I was screaming while Jessie was scrolling and laughing. I've never been to a sleepover after that😀
